address: La Rôtisserie du Chambertin, 6 rue du Chambertin, Gevrey-Chambertin, 21220, France
bio: Bare stone walls, bench seating and a superb wooden counter set the scene in this bistro, which is housed in its parent hotel. Expertly crafted burgundy recipes take pride of place on the nostalgic menu: home-cured ham, poached egg in wine, Bresse poultry, profiteroles... Fantastic wine list!...
